intentEvidence: The Daily Notes Automator is an Obsidian plugin designed to streamline and automate the creation of daily notes within your vault.
problem: Manually creating and naming daily notes consistently and efficiently within a vault.
summary: Automates daily note creation by checking for existing notes and generating new ones using customizable file naming schemes and templates.
